fusions.name: Strung Like Herring
fusions.desc: Throws a barbed shaft that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then passes on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, dealing 50% of that to each. You hold up to 4 throws, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Silver Scatter
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 slim darts out in a spread, each dealing 3 water damage.

fusions.name: Slip the Current
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds, with +12% dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Next in the School
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a thrown point flies at the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
